exposed_pad.note: 5-pin DBV SOT-23 package has no exposed thermal pad (RθJC(bot) = n/a, p.5); Pin 4 (NC) may be tied to GND for improved thermal spreading on fixed versions (p.3).

tj_max_c.condition: Absolute maximum operating junction temperature TJ (-50°C to +150°C; recommended continuous TJ -40°C to +125°C, p.5)

pinout.name: IN
pinout.description: Wide input supply pin (2.4 V to 18 V recommended, 20 V abs max); place >= 1 uF nominal ceramic capacitor close to IN and GND.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.description: Active-high enable pin (>= 0.9 V ON, <= 0.4 V OFF; 20 V abs max — DO NOT float; tie directly to IN if shutdown is unused).

pinout.name: NC
pinout.description: No internal connection on fixed 3.3 V TPS7A2433DBVR (Pin 4 is FB on adjustable TPS7A2401DBVR); may float or tie to GND for thermal relief.

pinout.name: OUT
pinout.description: Regulated 3.3 V output (high-impedance in shutdown — no shutdown discharge); requires 1 uF to 100 uF (2.2 uF nom) ceramic capacitor.

vin_abs_max_v.condition: VIN and VEN abs max -0.3 V to 20 V (VOUT abs max min(VIN + 0.3 V, 20 V))

vin_min_v.condition: Family recommended operating VIN minimum (maintain VIN >= 3.3 V + VDO for 3.3 V regulation)

vin_max_v.condition: Maximum recommended operating input voltage (NOT 24 V industrial bus compatible)

vout_v.condition: Fixed 3.3 V option in DBV SOT-23-5 (Active Production, top marking '1XHF')

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: ±1.25% max over -40°C to +125°C TJ for fixed output versions (±0.5% max at TJ = 25°C)

iq_typ_ua.condition: 2.0 uA typ / 4.5 uA max at IOUT = 0 mA (rises to 15 uA typ at IOUT = 1 mA, ~180 uA at 200 mA per Fig. 6-12 p.8)

ishdn_typ_ua.condition: 325 nA (0.325 uA) typ / 650 nA max at VEN <= 0.4 V, VIN = 2.4 V, IOUT = 0 mA

design_gotchas.title: Large/Fast VIN Line Transients Trigger Brief Output Shutdown (Section 8.1.8, p.17)
design_gotchas.detail: Section 8.1.8 (p.17) and Figure 8-3 warn that a large or fast input voltage step can briefly shut down TPS7A24 for up to a few hundred microseconds during the transient. On hot-plugged 12 V/18 V adapters or switched multicell packs, limit VIN slew rate and step size with input RC/TVS filtering so VOUT does not brown out the MCU.

design_gotchas.title: 167.8 °C/W SOT-23-5 Thermal Limit Severely Derates 12 V–18 V Operation Far Below 200 mA
design_gotchas.detail: At VIN = 18 V to VOUT = 3.3 V, full 200 mA load dissipates 2.94 W (ΔT = 493 °C at 167.8 °C/W!). Even at 12 V -> 3.3 V and TA = 50 °C (75 °C budget to 125 °C TJ), continuous load is capped at ~51 mA (~16 mA at 18 V, 85 °C ambient). Always run thermal margin checks before replacing 5.5 V LDOs on high-VIN rails.

design_gotchas.title: No Shutdown Output Discharge (High-Z When Disabled) & Strict Do-Not-Float EN Rule
design_gotchas.detail: Section 7.3.6 (p.12) specifies that the 100 uA / 5.5 kOhm overshoot pulldown turns OFF when VEN < VEN(LOW), leaving VOUT high-impedance in shutdown—unlike active-discharge 'P' LDOs (TPS7A05P, TLV757P). Also Table 5-1 (p.3) explicitly forbids floating EN (tie to IN if unused); unlike TPS70933DBVR (7 V EN abs max), TPS7A24 EN tolerates 20 V.

design_gotchas.title: High 300 uVRMS Output Noise & Unlimited PMOS Reverse-Current Body Diode
design_gotchas.detail: To achieve 2.0 uA IQ at 18 V VIN, TPS7A24 exhibits 300 uVRMS noise even at VOUT = 1.24 V (p.6)—making it noisy for precision ADC/RF stages compared to TPS7A20 (6.2 uVRMS). Section 8.1.4 (p.15) also warns reverse current is unlimited if VOUT > VIN + 0.3 V; add an external Schottky or series input diode.

typical_use_cases: Always-on 2-cell to 4-cell Li-Ion (6 V–16.8 V) or 9 V/12 V battery-pack MCU rails requiring 2.0 uA standby IQ
Smoke/heat detectors, smart thermostats, PIR motion sensors, and utility meters needing 18 V VIN + ±1.25% accuracy
Lower-dropout (160 mV typ vs ~960 mV), 20 V-EN SOT-23-5 alternative to TPS70933DBVR on <= 18 V buses
Cordless power-tool and appliance housekeeping 3.3 V rails with low average standby current
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TPS7A2433DBVR is an 18 V (20 V abs max), 200 mA, ultra-low-IQ (2.0 uA typ at no load, 325 nA shutdown) fixed 3.3 V (±1.25% over -40°C to +125°C) LDO in a 5-pin DBV SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT). With low 160 mV typ / 250 mV max dropout at 200 mA and a 20 V-tolerant EN pin, it excels in multicell battery and 12 V standby rails, outperforming legacy high-VIN LDOs on dropout and EN voltage rating. Designers must respect its 167.8 °C/W thermal ceiling at high VIN, Section 8.1.8 fast-line-transient brief-shutdown hazard, high 300 uVRMS noise, high-Z shutdown output (no discharge), and unblocked reverse current.
